descricao_original: The ovary is covered by a serosa of epithelium overlying a thin connective tissue layer. However, rather than the expected simple squamous epithelium, the epithelium of this serosa is simple cuboidal and is called by the misnomer “germinal epithelium.” A dense connective tissue layer, tunica albuginea, lies beneath the serosa. Small follicles are located in the cortex beneath the tunica albuginea. 400x
